description: List upcoming assignment events for the authenticated student. Canvas caps this endpoint at roughly the next 1 week and at most 20 events server-side — neither limit is adjustable, and results silently stop there even if more assignments fall later. For a longer or specific date range, use `list_calendar_events` with `type="assignment"` and explicit `start_date`/`end_date` instead.
name: get_my_upcoming_assignments
title: Get My Upcoming Assignments
